registration_note: Declared 2026-10-11 under config/strategy_search_v1.json before any candidate was backtested. 22 web candidates were collected (notes: research_notes/Web strategy search and validation/round1_*.md); 7 pass the eligibility screen. Ambiguities are resolved below once, before testing. Trials used after this round: 7 of 40.

screened_out.GTAA_Faber: excluded family (multi-asset time-series trend on index ETFs)
screened_out.DAA_Keller: top-N parameter not published in retrieved sources
screened_out.fx_carry_QC: rate data discontinued, sizing unspecified; carry family
screened_out.gold_fed_model_QC: threshold rarely triggers in data era; no published result
screened_out.overnight_drift: two trades per day; 10 bps round trip per day exceeds published gross return
screened_out.pre_fomc_drift: daily bars cannot reproduce the 2pm-2pm window; post-publication evidence of disappearance
screened_out.pre_holiday: documented disappearance for large caps; holiday list not retrieved

common.data: Yahoo daily adjusted close (dividends and splits) via orderflow_edge_lab.etf_history_holdout.fetch_yahoo_daily; FRED via fredgraph.csv; month-end = last trading day of the month; signals computed at the close of the signal day and applied from the next trading day's close-to-close return
common.cost: 10 bps round trip on traded weight (5 bps per side)

candidates.rule: monthly; momentum 13612W = 12*r1m + 4*r3m + 2*r6m + 1*r12m (month-end total returns); b = count of risky with momentum < 0; CF = min(1, b/B); n = round_half_up((1-CF)*T) risky slots, each weight 1/T, filled by the top-n risky by momentum; remaining weight to the cash asset with the highest momentum

monthly; MOM = P_t / mean(last 12 month-end closes incl. t) - 1; n0 = count of risky with MOM <= 0; safe share = min(1, n0/6); remainder split equally over the top 6 risky with MOM > 0 (weight (1-safe)/6 each); unfilled slots go to IEF
monthly; R12 = 12-month total return; tbill12 = mean(DTB3 over last 12 months)/100; if R12(SPY) > tbill12: hold whichever of SPY, EFA has the higher R12; else hold AGG
hold SPY over trading days -1, +1, +2, +3 around each month end (enter at the close of day -2, exit at the close of day +3); otherwise cash

candidates.source: R-bloggers 'Which Implied Volatility Ratio Is Best?' (QuantStrat TradeR)
candidates.rule: ratio = VIX/VIX3M; long SVXY on day t if ratio(t-2) < 1 and ratio(t-2) < SMA60(ratio)(t-2); otherwise cash (SVXY's leverage change in 2018 is accepted as published instrument behaviour)

candidates.source: Driesprong, Jacobsen & Maat 2008 via QuantConnect strategy library
candidates.rule: at each month end, OLS of SPY monthly return on the previous month's WTI return over the last 24 monthly pairs; forecast next month from this month's WTI return; hold SPY next month if forecast > DTB3/100/12, else cash. Data substitution: QC's discontinued oil and T-bill series replaced by FRED (logged)

candidates.source: QuantConnect strategy library, momentum and style rotation
candidates.rule: monthly (first trading day); momentum = P_t/P_(t-240 trading days) - 1; +0.5 weight on the highest, -0.5 on the lowest (page text version; the page's code sorts the other way, the text is taken as the published intent)

nulls.allocation: 999 books: each rebalance date keeps the real weight vector but assigns it to a random permutation of the candidate's available assets (review_methods.matched_random_selection_returns), seed 20261011
nulls.timing: 999 position series with the same number of invested days and the same distribution of in-market spell lengths, spells placed at random (block shuffle of runs), seed 20261011
